sources.finding: Official release states Images 2.5 is available in ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work and Codex; API Sunburst is intended for detailed creative work.
Official model page calls Sunburst the most capable image generation/editing model and lists max among supported quality settings.

limitation: The builtin tool has no model or quality selectors; official product/API availability does not prove a specific branch or quality for a host-managed call.
